verdict.rationale: Snyk Container is explicitly documented to find and fix vulnerabilities in container images, enabling security to be built in before deployment, and Snyk's broader platform description confirms scanning across container images alongside OS-package and application layers. Community feedback focuses on Snyk Open Source/appsec PR quality rather than disputing container scanning, with one comment even noting positive impressions of the container security tools specifically. Missing for 10: detailed hands-on evidence distinguishing OS-layer vs application-layer detection depth, and independent verification of container scan accuracy.
